title: Explosion sort cards
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Seeded from science/y9 lesson 26 (Explosion sort cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 26: Types of explosion. To understand the difference between chemical and physical explosions and what a fuel needs to burn

cards:
combustion
a reaction with oxygen that
releases energy as heat and light

fuel
a substance that releases
energy when burned

fire triangle
fuel, oxygen and heat: all
three are needed for burning

chemical explosion
a very fast reaction making
lots of hot gas

physical explosion
a container bursting from gas
pressure, with no new substance
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: How does a fire blanket put out a pan fire?
questions.a: It cuts off the oxygen, removing one side of the fire triangle
questions.model: Which side does a blanket remove? It covers the fire, so air cannot reach it. No oxygen, no combustion.

questions.q: Is a firework a chemical or physical explosion?
Why is flour dust dangerous but a bag of flour is not?
questions.a: Dust has a much larger surface area in contact with oxygen

questions.q: Sort eight events (gas leak explosion, bursting tyre, firework, popping crisp packet, flour mill explosion, steam boiler bursting, burning candle, aerosol can in a fire) into chemical explosion, physical explosion or neither, with a reason each.
questions.a: Chemical: gas leak, firework, flour mill. Physical: tyre, crisp packet, steam boiler, aerosol can in a fire (the can bursts; the contents may then burn). Neither: candle (slow combustion)
questions.model: Teacher does the first: gas leak: chemical, because methane burns very fast making hot gases.

questions.q: Explain how each type of fire extinguisher works using the fire triangle (water, foam, CO₂).
questions.a: Water removes heat; foam and CO₂ remove oxygen.

questions.q: Why must you never use water on a chip-pan fire?
questions.a: Water sinks, boils instantly and throws burning oil out, spreading the fire.

questions.q: The fire triangle is fuel, oxygen and...
Big question: how can flour dust explode?
questions.a: Its huge surface area lets it burn almost instantly with air and a spark.
